نتخانق (form VI)
# نَتَخَانَقُ (nataḵānaqu) /na.ta.xaː.na.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَانَقَ (taḵānaqa)
# نَتَخَانَقَ (nataḵānaqa) /na.ta.xaː.na.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَانَقَ (taḵānaqa)
# نَتَخَانَقْ (nataḵānaq) /na.ta.xaː.naq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَانَقَ (taḵānaqa)
